question: Find all unit vectors parallel to $2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-\hat{k}$. Explain why two answers are obtained.

options.A: The only unit vector parallel to the given vector is $\frac{2}{3}\hat{i}+\frac{2}{3}\hat{j}-\frac{1}{3}\hat{k}$.
options.B: The unit vectors are $\pm\left(\frac{2}{3}\hat{i}+\frac{2}{3}\hat{j}-\frac{1}{3}\hat{k}\right)$; two answers arise because parallel vectors may point in either of two opposite directions.
options.C: The unit vectors are $\pm(2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-\hat{k})$ because the given vector is already a unit vector.
